summary: Frontend-only test of /inscricao/endereco red error-box fix (same pattern applied from iteration_11 /inscricao/contato). Both scenarios PASS. Scenario 1 (all fields empty → Próximo): .erro-campos-donas rendered inside shadowRoot, visibility=visible, display=flex, position=static (fallback fixed NOT needed), rect{left:405, top:528, width:1140, height:173}, inViewport=true, text lists all 6 missing fields (CEP, Logradouro, Número, Bairro, Estado, Cidade), URL remained /inscricao/endereco. Scenario 2 (CEP=59000-000 + Número=100): ViaCEP could not find CEP (shows 'CEP não encontrado — preencha manualmente' inline hint — expected), click Próximo shows error box listing remaining missing fields (Logradouro, Bairro, Estado, Cidade). URL still /inscricao/endereco. Screenshots confirm visual presence of red box near/below Próximo button in both cases. Fix works identically to Contato step.
critical_code_review_comments: mostrarErroCampos is duplicated across inscricao-*.html files — consider extracting into a shared JS module (/app/frontend/public/js/inscricao-common.js) to reduce maintenance overhead across 5+ pages

Scenario 2 could not navigate to /inscricao/informacoes because CEP 59000-000 is not resolvable by ViaCEP in this environment; not a bug in fix — the validation correctly listed only truly-missing fields
